enhancedvoting.recipe: Enhanced Voting public sample-ballot JSON API (the vendor app the state itself links for sample ballots). Every request needs header 'X-CSRF: 1' (plain GET, no login, no cookie). Steps: (1) GET {api}/jurisdiction/{state} -> parent id; (2) GET {api}/jurisdiction/{parentId}/localities/?includeElection=true -> every county with its election ids; (3) GET {api}/jurisdiction/{countyId}/election/{electionId}/ballotStyles?excludeFederalOnly=false -> every ballot style with its precincts/splits; (4) GET {api}/ballotStyle/{styleGuid}?jurisdictionId={countyId}&precinctId={precincts[0].id}&ballotType=sample -> full ballot JSON (ballotItems = every contest, candidate, party, question text). {api}=https://app.enhancedvoting.com/ebd/voter/api . Without X-CSRF the API answers 401; ballotType=official answers 404.
